content:
marco (secops): Auditor asked for a compact package showing RBAC elevates, KMS grant activity, and vuln triage notes from the 2026-03-02 outage. Can we scope minimal exports?
tara (platform): Which services? I can grab IAM policy change events, STS AssumeRole, and KMS grant/crypto ops across aws us-west-2 and gcp-us-central1.
marco (secops): Incident INC-2026-0302-11. They need: (1) policy diff around the window, (2) grant create/revoke with TTLs, (3) list of principals that used emergency roles, (4) vuln ticket linking the elevated access to the mitigation plan.
nina (compliance): Also need mapping to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9.2 control IDs. Prefer CSV manifest + one-line md5/sha256 per file. Auditor said CSV columns: ts, principal, event, resource, request_id, src_ip.
auditor_marc: If you include a short signed statement describing how ephemeral grants are issued, that speeds closure. We accept PGP-signed text or PDF.
tara (platform): I'll run two queries: Splunk for AWS CloudTrail and GCP Audit logs. Example Splunk (AWS):
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=CreateGrant OR eventName=RevokeGrant OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=AssumeRole | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters.keyId requestID sourceIPAddress
```
And GCP: filter protoPayload.methodName:(google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.GenerateRandomBytes OR SetIamPolicy OR TestIamPermissions)

marco (secops): Add a filter for grants with expiration <= 1h and list original grantCreator justification (if present). Auditor wants proof TTL enforcement.
tara (platform): For policy diffs I'll pull iam-policy-change events and attach the before/after JSON as separate files. I'll compute SHA256 for each artifact like: `SHA256(inc-2026-0302-11-aws-cloudtrail.gz)= daa3...1b8f`.
artifact_bot: evidence-bundle queued (job_id=ev-3326-01), will attach job log when done.
nina (compliance): I'll drop the control mapping doc (control-mapping-soc2-iso-2026-03-02.pdf) into the bucket and include a one-page narrative linking each artifact to a control objective.
auditor_marc: Please also include who downloaded or viewed the evidence bucket and timestamps (chain-of-custody). We need to show that artifacts weren't altered after export.
marco (secops): Tara, can you include a small `actions.csv` with columns user,action,timestamp,ip for all artifact-store access?
tara (platform): Yes. Also will set object-lock and server-side encryption with KMS CMK and note the key id in the manifest. Bucket: `s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0302-11/` retention 45d per legal ask.
artifact_bot: object-lock applied to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0302-11/ (retention=45d).
tara (platform): Uploading artifacts now:
- inc-2026-0302-11-cloudtrail.json.gz (sha256: daa3...1b8f)
- inc-2026-0302-11-gcpaudit.json.gz (sha256: 7f4b...e02c)
- iam-policy-before.json (sha256: c3e9...4b66)
- iam-policy-after.json (sha256: f9a1...88ad)
- actions.csv (sha256: 5b2c...99dd)
- vuln-TRIAGE-4276.md (sha256: 2aa8...b334)
Pre-signed bundle: https://evidence.redwood.example/s/INC-2026-0302-11.tgz?exp=7d

nina (compliance): I'll add the SOC2/ISO crosswalk and a short attestation: "Artifacts exported from immutable logs, checksums verified, no post-export edits."
auditor_marc: Downloaded and verified checksums for cloudtrail and policy diffs. Quick question: the policy diff shows a temporary inline policy attached to role `ops-emergency-temp`. Can you include the ticket that authorized that inline policy?
marco (secops): Ticket ENG-6599-authorize-temprole-redacted.pdf added. It includes approver signature and PagerDuty incident link.
auditor_marc: Good. With that and the actions.csv I can map the grant issuance to the authority. I may request a short replay of the STS logs for a narrower window (14:05-14:40 UTC) to confirm the exact AssumeRole sequence.
tara (platform): I can run that narrower STS export and append as `sts-window-1405-1440.json.gz`. ETA 3 hours.
marco (secops): Thanks team. Action owners: tara (platform) = exports+hashes+sts narrow export; nina (compliance) = crosswalk+attestation; marco = cover note and upload retention check.
auditor_marc: Thanks. Please leave the bucket presigned link active for 7 days and send me the SHA256 lines in the manifest file so I can ingest automatically.
tara (platform): Manifest file uploaded: manifest.csv (sha256: 0d9f...c701) — includes one-line SHA256 per object.
auditor_marc: Verified manifest and initial artifacts. Will follow up after I ingest STS narrow export. Thanks.
marco (secops): Closing thread unless auditor requests more. If you need traces, we can run more targeted SIEM queries.
